purpose: Single internal source of verified product facts. Platform-specific commerce and discovery records (OpenAI, Google, Perplexity, Schema.org) are generated FROM this file. Nothing here is published directly.
internal_item_id_note: Stable neutral internal identifier chosen for Phase 2A. No pre-existing internal item ID was found in this repository; the only prior identifier strings (JUMVI-001, JMV-TC-001) appear solely inside a noindex draft page and are unresolved - see identifiers.unresolved. This value is an INTERNAL key only and is never emitted as sku or mpn.

packaging_claims.website_box_mission_claim_note: The live homepage makes NO mission-count claim about the printed box. It describes the box only as 'a printed retail box with the physical set and Mission Card presented together'. There is therefore no on-site contradiction to resolve.

gtin.policy: Do not assert a GTIN in any feed until an independently verified 8/12/13/14-digit value with a valid check digit is on file.

identifiers.public_sku_mpn_note: Intentionally null. Emitting either unresolved string as a public sku/mpn would publish an unverified product identity claim.

marketplace.source: Live homepage 'View on Amazon' links resolve to the ASIN detail page; jumvi.co has no cart or checkout.

media.format_note: These are WebP. The OpenAI product feed spec requires a direct JPEG or PNG link for image_url, so a JPEG/PNG derivative must be produced before any feed submission. Tracked in platform-readiness.md.
media.crawlable_source: Phase 1 removed the asset-level X-Robots-Tag and allowed Googlebot-Image / Bingbot-Image; /assets/ now serves index, follow, max-image-preview:large.

dynamic_offer_facts._note: Price and availability are live Amazon offer facts. They are deliberately absent as static values. Any generator that needs them MUST resolve them at build time through the interface below and MUST fail closed if resolution fails.

candidates: Amazon Product Advertising API 5.0 (GetItems: Offers.Listings.Price, Offers.Listings.Availability)
Amazon Selling Partner API (Product Pricing) for the seller's own listing

contract.on_failure: Do not emit the record. Never substitute a cached, estimated or previously seen value.

ratings_and_reviews._note: No rating or review data is asserted anywhere in this project. Amazon review data belongs to Amazon and is not republished here.

physical_attributes._note: Not asserted. No verified source in this project for product or package dimensions, weight, or materials beyond the EVA paddle construction stated in the contents list.

canonical_description: JUMVI is a 2–4 player toss-and-catch activity set for ages 3–12 with 4 hand-strap paddles, 4 sticky balls and 36 Guided Missions across 6 skill packs. The Mission Hub opens in a mobile browser from the QR Mission Card — no app download and no signup.

drift_targets._note: Fields the validator compares against the live homepage JSON-LD at https://www.jumvi.co/ to detect factual drift between this file and what is actually published.
